## Quarantined scope `roslyn/msbuild-bootstrap`

This directory contains the quarantined `roslyn/msbuild-bootstrap` scope: types in the Workspace layer in `SlideRule.Roslyn.MsBuild.*`. Here be dragons: do not spread references into it.

Dragons: We pick a VS 16/17 via vswhere and hand it to the out-of-process BuildHost through VSINSTALLDIR/VSCMD_VER=99.0. That preference is caution about a moving target, not a live workaround: the TypeInitializationException (XMakeElements) on legacy-namespace projects came from an early VS 18 preview and does not reproduce on VS 18.6. Where no 16/17 is installed, the highest available is taken and MsBuildBootstrap.LastSelection says so — the CLI prints it beside any workspace-load diagnostic, and SLIDERULE_VS_INSTALL_PATH overrides the choice. Do NOT switch to MSBuildLocator.QueryVisualStudioInstances — on .NET it returns no VS Setup instances.

- `roslyn/msbuild-bootstrap/containment` — Types in the Workspace layer in `SlideRule.Roslyn.MsBuild.*`, except types named `MsBuildBootstrap`, must be referenced only by types in the Workspace layer in `SlideRule.Roslyn.MsBuild.*` or types named `MsBuildBootstrap`. Fragile host bootstrap; contain it behind MsBuildBootstrap.
- Sanctioned surface: types named `MsBuildBootstrap`.
- Expand: `sliderule explain roslyn/msbuild-bootstrap/containment`.
